# anxcloud_network_prefix (Data Source)

Provides details about an Anexia Cloud network prefix. This data source is useful if you want to use a non-Terraform managed prefix.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "anxcloud_network_prefix" "by_cidr" {
  cidr = "10.0.0.0/24"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `cidr` (String) Network prefix CIDR.
- `id` (String) Network prefix identifier.

### Read-Only

- `description_customer` (String) Additional customer description.
- `description_internal` (String) Internal description.
- `ip_version` (Number) IP version: 4 for IPv4 or 6 for IPv6.
- `location_id` (String) Identifier of the prefix location.
- `locations` (List of Object) Anexia Cloud Locations. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--locations))
- `netmask` (Number) Network mask size.
- `role_text` (String) Role of the prefix.
- `router_redundancy` (Boolean) Whether router redundancy is enabled.
- `status` (String) Prefix status.
- `type` (Number) Prefix type: 0 for public or 1 for private.
- `vlan_id` (String) Corresponding VLAN identifier.

<a id="nestedatt--locations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `locations`

Read-Only:

- `city_code` (String)
- `code` (String)
- `country` (String)
- `identifier` (String)
- `lat` (String)
- `lon` (String)
- `name` (String)
